item.title: Knights of Columbus sells remaining stake in New Haven office tower for $14M as occupancy nears 90%
item.description: A real estate investment group has completed its purchase of a New Haven waterfront office tower, buying out its partner for $14 million and taking full control of the property.

item.title: 🔒 CT lawmakers revisit tax credits for office, retail conversions to housing
item.description: State lawmakers are again advancing legislation designed to encourage the conversion of commercial properties into housing.

item.title: CT-based hot yoga studio adding 1st franchise in West Hartford
item.description: A Connecticut-based hot yoga studio plans to expand into West Hartford, marking its first franchise location.

item.title: GOP-sponsored bill would eliminate various license, certification fees in CT
item.description: A bill introduced by all 11 Republican members of the state Senate seeks to eliminate a variety of occupational and professional licensing and certification fees.

item.title: 🔒 Middletown credit union names new CEO following strategic rebrand
item.description: Ellafi Federal Credit Union, formerly known as Seasons Federal Credit Union, has named longtime executive Robyn Swanson as its new CEO.

item.title: 🔒 Following merger, former Berkshire Bank branches in Greater Hartford adopt Beacon Bank name
item.description: Boston-based Beacon Financial Corp. has completed the rebranding of its banking operations to Beacon Bank, months after finalizing a merger that reshaped its presence in Connecticut.

item.title: 🔒 Bill would boost AWA’s board power as PURA prepares final ruling on Aquarion sale
item.description: Connecticut lawmakers are considering changes to the enabling legislation that set the stage for Aquarion Water Co.’s proposed $2.4 billion sale, with a public hearing on the measure scheduled for Tuesday as regulators work toward a final ruling on the deal.
